glossary.hi: Bharatiya manak jisme utpad ki gunvatta/suraksha apekshaen likhi hoti hain, jaise IS 10500 peene ke paani ke liye.
glossary.en: An Indian Standard is a documented quality/safety specification published by BIS, e.g. IS 10500 for drinking water. It is not a certificate by itself.

glossary.hi: Quality Control Order me un utpadon ke liye nirdharit Bharatiya Manak ka palan anivarya hota hai. Aadesh aur uska daayra BIS se jaanchen.
glossary.en: A Quality Control Order names products for which compliance with a specified Indian Standard is compulsory. Check the order and its scope with BIS.

glossary.hi: BIS dwara diya gaya licence number jo utpad par ISI mark ke saath lagta hai.
glossary.en: Licence number issued by BIS, printed with the ISI mark on certified products.

glossary.hi: Sone/chandi ke gehne par 6-ank ka HUID number jo BIS Care app par verify hota hai.
glossary.en: 6-digit Hallmark Unique ID on gold/silver articles, verifiable on the BIS Care app.

glossary.hi: Electronics/IT utpadon ke liye factory visit ke bina registration (jaise LED lamp).
glossary.en: Compulsory Registration Scheme for electronics/IT — lab test + registration, no factory inspection.

glossary.hi: Videshi nirmataon ke liye BIS licence yojana; Bharat me AIR chahiye.
glossary.en: Scheme for foreign manufacturers; requires an Authorised Indian Representative.
